notes.title: Spanish (Latin America) Localization Update
notes.notes:
As the title of this announcement implies, the game is now fully playable in Latin American Spanish! The Steam Store page is localized as well. Thank you to Joaquín Masimelli, who reached out to me and made this update possible.

Happy belated Easter, and thanks for playing Bean Busy!

notes.title: Achievement Update
notes.notes:
Hello there! Apologies to anybody who has been waiting for steam achievement support, but here it finally is. My life has [i]bean[/i] a bit rough as of late, but it would be criminal if I didn't add achievements sooner or later. Just to be thorough, here are all of the changes/additions...

- Steam achievement support
- More polish (literally, look at those keys!)
- bug fixes to a certain late game enemy
- balancing to some late game content

I will probably add more achievements at some point, especially if a certain concept I've had for the game ends up panning out. Thank you for taking interest in Bean Busy.
